title: Assault on Fort Slava
summary: Marleyan ground forces and Eldian warrior candidates assault the Mid-East Allied Forces stronghold at Fort Slava.

title: Destruction of the Mid-East Naval Fleet
summary: The Beast Titan and Armored Titan destroy the Mid-East naval fleet in the bay to seal victory.
because: Fort Slava artillery has been neutralized allowing the Titans to attack the warships directly.

title: Warriors Return to Liberio
summary: The Eldian warrior candidates and Titan shifters return by train to their families in the Liberio Internment Zone.
because: The victory at Fort Slava concludes the war and grants the troops temporary leave.

title: Conference Between Willy Tybur and Magath
summary: Willy Tybur meets Commander Magath to plan a global theatrical event in Liberio.

title: Falco Befriends a Wounded Soldier
summary: Falco speaks with an injured Eldian veteran named Kruger resting at the local hospital.

title: Delivery of Letters from the Hospital
summary: Falco secretly deposits letters into an external mailbox on behalf of the wounded soldier Kruger.
because: Kruger claims he wishes to send messages to his family without hospital censorship.

title: Falco Guides Reiner to a Basement
summary: Falco leads Reiner Braun away from the festival crowd into a secluded basement beneath a residential building.
because: Falco believes his wounded soldier acquaintance has an important private message for Reiner.

title: Confrontation Beneath the Stage
summary: Reiner discovers that the wounded soldier in the basement is Eren Yeager.
because: Eren has infiltrated Liberio and summoned Reiner prior to the international festival speech.

title: Willy Tybur's Address at the Festival
summary: Willy Tybur reveals the history of King Fritz and proclaims war against the island of Paradis.
because: Marley seeks an international coalition to eliminate the threat posed by Paradis Island.

title: Transformation in the Liberio Plaza
summary: The Attack Titan bursts through the building behind the stage and attacks Willy Tybur.
because: Eren launches a preemptive assault at the conclusion of Willy Tybur's declaration.

title: The Tybur Titan Enters the Battle
summary: Lara Tybur transforms into the War Hammer Titan to battle the Attack Titan in Liberio.
because: Willy Tybur's demise forces the Tybur family to deploy their hidden military asset.

title: Survey Corps Deploys in Liberio
summary: Mikasa Ackerman and the Survey Corps arrive equipped with anti-personnel gear to support Eren.
because: The Scouts carry out an extraction operation to rescue Eren and eliminate Marleyan leadership.

title: Colossal Titan Destroys the Port Fleet
summary: Armin Arlert transforms into the Colossal Titan in Liberio harbor and annihilates the Marleyan navy.
because: The Scouts must eliminate Marleyan naval reinforcements and secure the escape vector.

title: Breaching the War Hammer Crystal
summary: Eren uses the jaws of the subdued Jaw Titan to crush the crystal containing Lara Tybur.
because: Conventional titan strikes cannot penetrate the hardened crystal encasing the War Hammer's body.

title: Survey Corps Boards the Escape Airship
summary: The Survey Corps completes their offensive and retreats aboard an airship piloted by Onyankopon.
because: Their primary tactical objectives in Liberio have been achieved.

title: Warrior Candidates Infiltrate the Airship
summary: Gabi Braun and Falco Grice ascend into the departing airship using a tether and shoot Sasha Braus.
because: Gabi seeks vengeance for the destruction of Liberio and the deaths of her friends.

title: Discovery of Zeke in the Airship Cabin
summary: The captured warrior candidates discover that Zeke is alive and collaborating with Paradis.
because: Zeke faked his death in Liberio to defect to the island alongside Eren and the Scouts.

title: Airship Lands on Paradis Island
summary: The airship touches down on Paradis Island where Eren is immediately placed under arrest by the military.
because: The military command views Eren's unsanctioned Liberio strike as treasonous insubordination.

title: Arrival of the Anti-Marleyan Volunteers
summary: Armin recalls how Yelena and the Anti-Marleyan Volunteers first arrived on the island three years earlier.

title: Hizuru Delegation Visits Paradis
summary: Kiyomi Azumabito presents Zeke's three-part proposal to Paradis military leaders during diplomatic talks.

title: Escape from the Military Stockade
summary: Gabi and Falco deceive their guard to escape detention and flee into the Paradis countryside.
because: The young candidates refuse to remain captive on the island and seek a way back to Marley.

title: Arrival at the Braus Stables
summary: A local girl named Kaya finds Gabi and Falco by the river and invites them to stay at the Braus family farm.
because: Kaya assumes the two runaways are impoverished orphans in need of food and shelter.

title: Bombing of the Premier's Office
summary: An explosive device detonates inside Premier Dhalis Zachary's headquarters, assassinating him.
because: Rogue military dissidents despise the high command's decision to imprison and replace Eren.

title: Formation of the Yeagerist Faction
summary: Eren escapes confinement using the War Hammer's powers and unites with Floch Forster's rebellious faction.
because: The defectors intend to unite Eren and Zeke to activate the Rumbling independently of military orders.

title: Confrontation at the Restaurant
summary: Nicolo attacks Falco and Gabi with a wine bottle after discovering that Gabi killed Sasha.
because: Nicolo loved Sasha and is overwhelmed by grief upon confronting her killer.

title: Revelation of the Tainted Wine
summary: Nicolo warns the Scouts that the Marleyan wine served to the military high command contains Zeke's spinal fluid.
because: Falco accidentally swallowed a mouthful of the spilled wine during the altercation.

title: Eren Confronts Armin and Mikasa
summary: Eren verbally berates Mikasa and engages Armin in a violent fistfight at the restaurant.
because: Eren claims Mikasa is bound by Ackerman instincts and Armin is manipulated by Bertholdt's memories.

title: Transformation in the Giant Forest
summary: Zeke unleashes a scream that transforms Levi's thirty Scout escorts into Pure Titans.
because: The Scout guards had consumed the tainted Marleyan wine distributed to the forest camp.

title: Subjugation in the Giant Forest
summary: Captain Levi slaughters his transformed comrades, pursues Zeke, and eviscerates the Beast Titan.
because: Levi refuses to let Zeke escape to rendez-vous with Eren and the Yeagerists.

title: Zeke's Recollection of Liberio
summary: A dying Zeke remembers his childhood under Grisha and Dina and his mentorship under Tom Ksaver.

title: Detonation in the Wagon
summary: Zeke intentionally triggers the live Thunder Spear embedded in his torso, blowing himself and Levi apart.
because: Zeke gambles his survival to break free from Levi's torturous confinement.

title: Pieck Infiltrates Shiganshina Headquarters
summary: Pieck Finger pretends to surrender to Eren before tricking him onto the fortress rooftop.
because: Pieck aims to lure Eren into an exposed position for an ambush by Marleyan forces.

title: Marley Airships Descend on Shiganshina
summary: General Magath leads a surprise Marleyan airborne fleet that descends directly over Shiganshina.
because: Marley launches an immediate retaliatory strike to reclaim the Founding Titan before Eren can activate its power.

title: Three-Way Clash in Shiganshina
summary: Marleyan paratroopers and Titan shifters engage Eren Yeager in fierce urban combat across the district.
because: Marley's airborne fleet arrives over Shiganshina to launch a surprise counter-invasion against Eren.

title: Bombardment from Wall Maria
summary: The Beast Titan mounts the southern wall of Shiganshina and bombards Marleyan forces with boulders.
because: Eren is pinned down and overwhelmed by the combined assault of the Armored and Jaw Titans.

title: Porco's Final Sacrifice in Shiganshina
summary: A critically wounded Porco Galliard allows the newly transformed pure Titan Falco to consume him.
because: Zeke's scream transforms Falco into a rampaging pure Titan who attacks Reiner during the clash.

title: Encounter Beneath the Great Tree
summary: A hunted slave girl falls into a chasm beneath a giant tree and comes into contact with a mysterious primordial anomaly.

title: Appeal to the Progenitor in Paths
summary: Eren embraces Ymir in the Paths realm and urges her to decide her own destiny rather than obey the royal line.
because: Ymir has remained bound to the commands of royal blood by two millennia of psychological enslavement.

title: Clearing the Pure Titans in Shiganshina
summary: The Survey Corps and garrison troops eliminate the rampaging Titans left behind after the wall collapse.
because: The collapse of the district walls leaves the military garrison surrounded by rampaging pure Titans.

title: Dissolution of the Hardened Cocoon
summary: Annie Leonhart awakens in the Stohess underground after her protective crystal casing abruptly dissolves.
because: Eren commands the total undoing of all Titan hardening across Paradis Island.

title: Confrontation Around the Campfire
summary: The remaining Scouts and Marleyan Warriors share a meal in the forest and confront their violent history.
because: The surviving factions must reconcile their enmity to form an alliance against the Rumbling.

title: Stand-off at the Southern Port
summary: Armin and Connie attempt to secure the Azumabito flying boat at the port without alerting Yeagerist guards.
because: The allied coalition requires the flying boat at the port to pursue Eren before he reaches the mainland.

title: Skirmish at the Port of Paradis
summary: The Allied forces fight through defending Yeagerists to tow the Azumabito mechanics and flying boat to sea.
because: The peaceful ruse collapses into bloodshed when the Yeagerist guards realize they are being betrayed.

title: Detonation of the Captured Cruiser
summary: A Marleyan gunboat is set ablaze and blown apart to prevent Yeagerist forces from pursuing the alliance ship.
because: Yeagerist reinforcements with naval artillery threaten to pursue and intercept the escaping alliance ship.

title: Survey Corps Reconnaissance in Marley
summary: The Survey Corps travels across the sea in disguise to evaluate the potential for peace with continental nations.

title: Rearguard Stand at the Odiha Airfield
summary: Hange Zoë slays approaching colossal titans to buy time for the engineers to launch the flying boat.
because: The Rumbling reaches the coastal hangar before technicians can finish fueling the flying boat.

title: Resurgence in the Realm of Paths
summary: Armin Arlert and Zeke Yeager awaken past Titan inheritors to assist the Alliance on the battlefield.
because: The alliance's airborne assault is overwhelmed by the puppet Titan army summoned atop Eren's founding form.

title: Dissolution of the Power of Titans
summary: Mikasa Ackerman slays Eren Yeager within the colossal titan's mouth, causing all Titan powers to vanish forever.
because: The awakening of past shifters turns the battle and allows Levi to breach Eren's mouth for Mikasa.
